releaseNotesKm: អេក្រង់ស្ថិតិថ្មី៖ កិច្ចការរួចរាល់ នាទីផ្តោតអារម្មណ៍ ទម្លាប់ ព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ និងពេលវេលាតាមប្រភេទ គិតតាមថ្ងៃ សប្តាហ៍ ខែ និងឆ្នាំ។ រយៈពេលដែលមិនទាន់ចប់បង្ហាញថា «ដល់ថ្ងៃនេះ» ហើយធៀបនឹងចំណុចដូចគ្នានៃរយៈពេលមុន។ គណនាទាំងអស់ក្នុងទូរស័ព្ទ។ ជួសជុលបញ្ហា៖ ការដកសញ្ញាកិច្ចការរួចរាល់មិនរក្សាពេលវេលាទៀតទេ ហើយទម្លាប់ត្រូវវាស់ចាប់ពីថ្ងៃដែលបានបង្កើត។
releaseNotesEn: A statistics screen that reports rather than grades: tasks completed, focus minutes, habits, events and time by category, by day, week, month and year. A period still running is marked and compared against the same point in the previous one, so a Tuesday is not measured against a whole week. Everything is computed on the device from data already there - no new table, nothing collected, nothing uploaded. Three bugs fixed along the way: un-ticking a task recorded a completion time instead of clearing it, habits were judged for days before they were created, and a weekly-target habit was measured per day.
